name: integration-dev6-on
note: The integration-night composition (2026-08-29): baseline + teeBorderCornerFit (border-adjacency corner claims into the shared recoveredTees pool, before assignment). phantomTee is deliberately ABSENT: the engine is course-blind, so a shared-config whitelist entry like AC12 fabricates a phantom on EVERY course whose listed hole is unassigned -- observed filling five holes with junk across Dev6. Phantom injection belongs only in a course-specific config (phantom-tee-whitelist-on) until whitelist entries can be scoped to a course.
